meta.title: Darbars (Shrines) of Pakistan
notes: Urs dates follow the Islamic lunar calendar and shift about 10-11 days earlier each year; confirm locally.
Death years and some details come from traditional accounts and may differ between sources; 'Uncertain' marks unknown values.
Addresses are area-level. Source links that open a Wikipedia search should be matched to the right article.
